headline: A federal law renames a Postal Service building in Rio Grande, New Jersey, after Carlton H. Hand.
what_it_does: This act names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 1087 Route 47 South in Rio Grande, New Jersey, the Carlton H. Hand Post Office Building. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, mail delivery, or staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 4, 2025.
